interface.name: infinity_focus_manager_v1
interface.description:
MalaysiaDreams focus mode (ADR 0051): a maximized window gets a space of its own and the xdg fullscreen state. In that space, the pointer at the top edge brings the bar down; a client-decorated window is moved down by the bar's height so its own titlebar stays visible under it.
This global tells a client-decorated application when that happens, so it can hide its window controls while in focus mode and show them with the bar, as macOS does. It carries no geometry and grants nothing, so every client may bind it.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Objects created through it keep working.

request.name: get_focus_surface

description.summary: follow focus mode for a toplevel surface

request.description: Creates an object that reports focus-mode notices for the toplevel whose wl_surface is given.

description.summary: focus mode notices for one toplevel

event.name: bar

description.summary: the bar came down or went up over the window

event.description: Sent while the toplevel is in focus mode (it has the xdg fullscreen state). revealed is 1 when the bar is down over the window, which has been moved down by the bar's height, and 0 when the bar is up again. A client shows its window controls only while revealed is 1. Leaving focus mode sends 0 if the bar was down.
